reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 7, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: When completing a symmetric figure, the two halves must be ___.
Half of a shape is shown. The line of symmetry is vertical. To complete the shape, what do you do?
samples_reviewed.correct_answer: Draw the mirror image on the other side of the line.

samples_reviewed.question_text: A symmetric figure has a horizontal line of symmetry. If the top half has 3 squares, how many squares are in the bottom half?
A symmetric figure has a horizontal line of symmetry. If the top half has 3 squares, how many squares are in the bottom half?
Half of a shape is shown. The line of symmetry is vertical. To complete the shape, what do you do?
samples_reviewed.correct_answer: Draw the mirror image on the other side of the line.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: 'Complete a figure' implies a production task, but seed 43's correct answer is only the description 'Draw the mirror image on the other side of the line' rather than an actual completed figure -- every sample asks about the completion process rather than performing it.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Both orientations named by figure-completion problems appear: vertical line of symmetry at seeds 43/46 and horizontal line of symmetry at seeds 44/45, plus an abstract definitional item at seed 42, giving reasonable structural coverage.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The longest stem, seed 44's 'A symmetric figure has a horizontal line of symmetry. If the top half has 3 squares, how many squares are in the bottom half?', splits into two clauses of about 8 and 12 words, fitting grade 3 quarter 4 comfortably.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only 3 distinct frames repeat across the 5 seeds (definition, procedure-description, square-counting), and the closest proxy to actual figure completion, the square-count items at 44/45, reduces 'completing a figure' to a numeric parity count rather than spatial completion.

competency_alignment.rationale: All 5 samples specifically concern completing a figure around a stated line of symmetry, correctly distinct from mat_g3_mg_q4_1's identification focus and mat_g3_mg_q4_0's translation focus despite the shared item pool.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The square count of 3 (seeds 44/45) is a small discrete value appropriate to grade 3 figure-completion content, not a numeric-range item.
